title: Conditions Governing a Confirmed Car Rental Given Up by the Renter
content:
Only the renter may cancel their own confirmed rental, and the cancellation is confirmed by the renter
rather than performed on their behalf. These are the conditions on which a Car Rental Rate Classes booking
is given up.

## The free-cancellation term

A cancellation is handled free of charge only when frozen time is not after the moment the supplier
confirmed the renter's booking plus the free-cancellation term of the rate class booked. Frozen time here
is the moment at which the desk is handling the matter.

The free-cancellation term is counted in whole elapsed hours from the confirmation moment, never mixing
elapsed hours with calendar days, and a cancellation confirmed exactly at the boundary is still free. The
term of each class, and the moment the supplier confirmed the booking, are both matters of record; what the
renter says about when they decided is not.

**Boundary cases, on a class whose term is a number of hours.** Take the confirmation moment as the anchor.
A cancellation confirmed on the boundary hour itself is inside the term and is free, because the comparison
asks only that the handling moment is not after the anchor plus the term. A cancellation confirmed one hour
after that boundary hour is outside the term. A class whose term is nothing has its boundary at the
confirmation moment itself, so a cancellation confirmed at any later hour is outside it.

## What is withheld

Inside the free-cancellation term nothing is withheld on any rate class, and *the prepayment is returned in
full* — that second limb is **no longer in force**, the basis on which money is returned now being the
current basis carried by the rate classes. The first limb stands: inside the term nothing is withheld.

The following clause is likewise **no longer in force** and must not be applied: *Outside it the charge is
read off the rate class's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the
scheduled collection; where the ladder yields nothing the class's flat cancellation charge applies instead,
and the two are never added.*

A class that returns nothing withholds the whole prepayment, and *the agency service fee is not returned on
any class* — that second limb is **no longer in force**, the retention of the service element now resting
on the current basis. The first limb stands.

## Two cases decided outside the charge

A cancellation made because the supplier itself cannot provide the vehicle is free on every class, whatever
the ladder says.

A cancellation after the scheduled collection time has passed is not a cancellation but a no-show, and the
no-show terms apply instead.
